body:
## Pull request overview

This PR completes `userFilters` end-to-end wiring so the Airtable Interfaces–style filter controls can be configured, persisted on `NamedListView`, and correctly passed through both Console and `plugin-view` ObjectView rendering paths.

**Changes:**
- Add `userFilters` to `NamedListView` to match `ListViewSchema.userFilters`.
- Pass `userFilters` through Console and `plugin-view` ObjectView schema construction.
- Add a User Filters editor to the Console view config panel (with i18n keys) and extend tests to cover the new field + passthrough behavior.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Adds `NamedListView.userFilters` type to align with `ListViewSchema`. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Passes `userFilters` into the ListView schema used for preview/render. |
| packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx | Passes `userFilters` into rendered view schema based on `activeView`. |
| apps/console/src/utils/view-config-schema.tsx | Implements the config-panel editor UI for `userFilters`. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts | Adds English strings for the new config UI controls. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts | Adds Chinese strings for the new config UI controls. |

</details>

`NamedListView.userFilters` duplicates the full `ListViewSchema['userFilters']` shape inline. Since this is explicitly meant to stay in parity, it’s easy for the two definitions to drift over time. Consider reusing the existing type (e.g., `userFilters?: ListViewSchema['userFilters']`) or extracting a shared `UserFiltersConfig` type alias used by both `ListViewSchema` and `NamedListView`.
```suggestion
  userFilters?: ListViewSchema['userFilters'];
```

ROADMAP entry mentions a `buildUserFiltersSection` implementation in ViewConfigPanel, but the current change adds `_userFilters` directly inside `buildDataSection` (no `buildUserFiltersSection` helper appears to exist). Consider updating this line to match the actual implementation (or introduce the named helper if that’s the intended structure).
```suggestion
- [x] UserFilters config panel: `_userFilters` integrated into `buildDataSection` in ViewConfigPanel — element type selector (dropdown/tabs/toggle), field picker, live preview sync, i18n (en/zh), `NamedListView.userFilters` type parity with `ListViewSchema.userFilters`
```

`showAllRecords` defaults to enabled at runtime (see plugin-list `showAllRecords={config.showAllRecords !== false}`), but this checkbox is rendered as unchecked when `uf.showAllRecords` is `undefined` (`checked={uf.showAllRecords === true}`). This makes the config panel disagree with actual behavior and can lead to saving a config that appears disabled but still shows the "All records" tab. Consider using `checked={uf.showAllRecords !== false}` (and when toggling, set `showAllRecords` to `false` when unchecked, otherwise `undefined` or `true` depending on whether you want to persist the default).
